# comp: asm → C names

Headers in `csrc/core/comp/`. `*` marks a label another module uses (`src/syms.inc`,
`src/ui/syms.inc`); the rest are statics of the module. The token cursor (asm `ESI`) is `comp.p`,
the code's next byte (`EDI`) `comp.out`; the readers also take any cursor as `const uint8_t **p`.

Compile errors: `repl_error` (io's `err_raise`), while `comp.busy` (asm `csp != 0`), calls
`comp_fail(code)`, which emits `ERR`, `EOL` and longjmps to `comp_text`, which returns normally.

## Generated by `tools/x86dfa.py` (C mode; `check` covers both)

`csrc/core/comp/dfa.h` (tables defined under `DFA_DATA`, in lexr.c) and `csrc/core/io/gen.h`
(gen.inc's `g_msgs`, `g_kwlist`, `g_kwlist1` as `cons_msgs`, `cons_kwlist`, `cons_kwlist1`, defined
under `GEN_DATA`).

## The expression tree (C only)

`cm_p` and `cm_un` emit as they parse; the C builds a tree instead (`comp/ast.h`): `parse` and
`parse_unary` make nodes, `fold_tree` folds each operator whose operands are literals (through
the VM's handlers, as `cm_fold`), and `gen` emits them with the asm's choices. A function call,
an element, a field or a string literal is compiled where it is met and kept as an `N_CODE` leaf.
The code is the asm's byte for byte over the golden corpus.
